I'll rebuild this TAS (Triple-Axis Spectrometer) instrument in McStas from the specification. This is a complex instrument with many components, so I'll work systematically through the beamline.

Let me start by creating the instrument and implementing the derived quantities and beamline.

input.description: Triple-Axis Spectrometer with velocity selector, curved guides, monochromator, and analyzer
